svg.title: RMSNorm rescales each token independently
svg.desc: Toy last input row [1,2,3,4] has mean square 7.5. RMSNorm divides by sqrt(7.5+1e-6), then multiplies by learned per-feature gain. Normalization reduces over four features only. The actual model reduces over 1536 features independently at each of 42 positions.

g.text: h = x * rsqrt(mean(x*x, dim=-1) + eps) * gain
Real input and output: [1, 42, 1536]; reduction axis = 1536
